001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.publisher;
002
003import java.lang.System.Logger.Level;
004import java.time.Duration;
005import java.util.Arrays;
006import java.util.Objects;
007import java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException;
008import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
009import java.util.concurrent.locks.Condition;
010import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock;
011
012import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
013
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogAlerts;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogAppender;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
017import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEvent;
018import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogMetrics;
019import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogMetrics.Gauge;
020import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
021import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher;
022import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.AsyncLogPublisher;
023import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisherRegistry;
024import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter;
025import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable;
026
027/**
028 * The default bounded async publisher with one output worker. Producers block when the
029 * pending buffer is full. Events are delivered in insertion order, including calls
030 * already waiting for space when shutdown begins. New calls are rejected during shutdown.
031 * Select it explicitly with the {@value LogPublisherRegistry#BATCH_SWAP_SCHEME} URI
032 * scheme to keep using it if the default async implementation changes.
033 * <p>
034 * Up to {@link BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisherBuilder#bufferSize(Integer) bufferSize} events
035 * may wait for delivery while another batch of up to that size is being written. The
036 * queued metric excludes the batch currently being written. Events passed directly to
037 * {@link #log(LogEvent)} must already be {@linkplain LogEvent#freeze() frozen}, as
038 * required by async publishers.
039 * <p>
040 * Closing waits for the configured timeout without interrupting output operations. If it
041 * times out, an error alert is recorded and the worker continues draining before closing
042 * the appender. Logging recursively from the worker is rejected to prevent deadlock.
043 * Rejected events increment {@link LogMetrics#EVENTS_DROPPED_METRIC}, with one error
044 * alert per rejection reason for each publisher. An interrupted producer can enqueue when
045 * space is available; interruption while waiting for space drops the event and preserves
046 * the interrupt flag.
047 */
048public final class BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher implements AsyncLogPublisher {
049
050        private final String name;
051
052        private final LogMetrics metrics;
053
054        private final AtomicInteger alertedReasons = new AtomicInteger();
055
056        private final LogAppender appender;
057
058        private final LogAlerts alerts;
059
060        private final Gauge queued;
061
062        private final long shutdownNanos;
063
064        private final Thread worker;
065
066        private final ReentrantLock lock = new ReentrantLock();
067
068        private final Condition readable = lock.newCondition();
069
070        private final Condition writable = lock.newCondition();
071
072        private final Condition terminated = lock.newCondition();
073
074        // All mutable queue and lifecycle state is protected by lock.
075        private LogEvent[] pending;
076
077        private int count;
078
079        private int producers;
080
081        private State state = State.NEW;
082
083        private enum State {
084
085                NEW, STARTING, RUNNING, CLOSING, FAILED, CLOSED
086
087        }
088
089        // The method reference is invoked only by start(), after construction has finished.
090        @SuppressWarnings("methodref.receiver.bound")
091        private BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher(String name, LogConfig config, LogAppender appender, int capacity,
092                        long shutdownNanos) {
093                this.name = name;
094                this.metrics = config.metrics();
095                this.appender = appender;
096                this.alerts = config.alerts();
097                this.queued = config.metrics().gauge(LogMetrics.EVENTS_QUEUED_METRIC, Level.INFO);
098                this.pending = new LogEvent[capacity];
099                this.shutdownNanos = shutdownNanos;
100                this.worker = new Thread(this::consume, "rainbowgum-batch-swap-async-" + name);
101                this.worker.setDaemon(true);
102        }
103
104        /**
105         * Default pending buffer capacity.
106         */
107        public static final int DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE = LogPublisherRegistry.ASYNC_BUFFER_SIZE;
108
109        /**
110         * Default time to wait for delivery and appender closure.
111         */
112        public static final Duration DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT = Duration
113                .ofMillis(LogPublisherRegistry.ASYNC_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT);
114
115        /**
116         * Creates a named builder. Call
117         * {@link BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisherBuilder#fromProperties(LogProperties)} to read
118         * {@code logging.publisher.<name>.bufferSize} and
119         * {@code logging.publisher.<name>.shutdownTimeout}. Properties override builder
120         * values when present. Select its factory with
121         * {@link LogRouter.Router.Builder#publisher(LogPublisher.PublisherFactory)}.
122         * @param name publisher name used for property lookup.
123         * @return builder.
124         */
125        public static BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisherBuilder builder(String name) {
126                return new BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisherBuilder(name);
127        }
128
129        /**
130         * Creates a publisher factory with validated options.
131         * @param name publisher name used for property lookup.
132         * @param bufferSize positive pending capacity, excluding the batch being written.
133         * @param shutdownTimeout nonnegative close timeout (property unit: milliseconds).
134         * @return publisher factory.
135         */
136        @LogConfigurable(name = "BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisherBuilder", prefix = LogProperties.PUBLISHER_PREFIX)
137        static PublisherFactory of(@LogConfigurable.KeyParameter String name,
138                        @LogConfigurable.DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE") Integer bufferSize,
139                        @LogConfigurable.DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT") @LogConfigurable.ConvertParameter("parseShutdownTimeout") Duration shutdownTimeout) {
140                if (bufferSize < 1) {
141                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("bufferSize must be positive.");
142                }
143                if (shutdownTimeout.isNegative()) {
144                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("shutdownTimeout must not be negative.");
145                }
146                long shutdownNanos;
147                try {
148                        shutdownNanos = shutdownTimeout.toNanos();
149                }
150                catch (ArithmeticException e) {
151                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("shutdownTimeout is too large.", e);
152                }
153                return (n, config, appenders) -> new BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher(n, config, appenders.asSingle(), bufferSize,
154                                shutdownNanos);
155        }
156
157        static Duration parseShutdownTimeout(String value) {
158                return Duration.ofMillis(Long.parseLong(value));
159        }
160
161        @Override
162        public void start(LogConfig config) {
163                lock.lock();
164                try {
165                        if (state == State.RUNNING) {
166                                return;
167                        }
168                        if (state != State.NEW) {
169                                throw new IllegalStateException("BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher cannot be restarted.");
170                        }
171                        state = State.STARTING;
172                        try {
173                                appender.start(config);
174                                state = State.RUNNING;
175                                worker.start();
176                        }
177                        catch (RuntimeException | Error e) {
178                                state = State.CLOSED;
179                                try {
180                                        appender.close();
181                                }
182                                catch (RuntimeException | Error closeFailure) {
183                                        e.addSuppressed(closeFailure);
184                                }
185                                throw e;
186                        }
187                }
188                finally {
189                        lock.unlock();
190                }
191        }
192
193        @Override
194        public void log(LogEvent event) {
195                Objects.requireNonNull(event);
196                @Nullable Drop reason;
197                if (Thread.currentThread().equals(worker)) {
198                        reason = Drop.REENTRANT;
199                }
200                else {
201                        lock.lock();
202                        try {
203                                reason = enqueueOrNull(event);
204                        }
205                        finally {
206                                lock.unlock();
207                        }
208                }
209                // Alert listeners can themselves log. Never call them under the queue lock.
210                if (reason != null) {
211                        dropped(reason, 1);
212                }
213        }
214
215        // Called with lock held. Null means the event was accepted.
216        private @Nullable Drop enqueueOrNull(LogEvent event) {
217                if (state != State.RUNNING) {
218                        return switch (state) {
219                                case NEW, STARTING -> Drop.NOT_STARTED;
220                                case FAILED -> Drop.WORKER_FAILED;
221                                default -> Drop.CLOSED;
222                        };
223                }
224                producers++;
225                try {
226                        while (count == pending.length && state != State.FAILED && state != State.CLOSED) {
227                                writable.await();
228                        }
229                        if (state == State.FAILED || state == State.CLOSED) {
230                                return Drop.WORKER_FAILED;
231                        }
232                        pending[count++] = event;
233                        queued.increment();
234                        if (count == 1) {
235                                readable.signal();
236                        }
237                        return null;
238                }
239                catch (InterruptedException e) {
240                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
241                        return Drop.INTERRUPTED;
242                }
243                finally {
244                        producers--;
245                        // Pass available space to one waiter, including when this caller
246                        // was interrupted. Avoid waking a herd that races to refill a batch.
247                        if (producers != 0 && count < pending.length) {
248                                writable.signal();
249                        }
250                        if (state == State.CLOSING && producers == 0) {
251                                readable.signal();
252                        }
253                }
254        }
255
256        private enum Drop {
257
258                NOT_STARTED(1 << 0, "the publisher has not been started"), CLOSED(1 << 1, "the publisher is closing or closed"),
259                INTERRUPTED(1 << 2, "the logging thread was interrupted while the buffer was full"),
260                REENTRANT(1 << 3, "the publisher's own thread logged recursively"),
261                WORKER_FAILED(1 << 4, "the worker stopped before delivering the event");
262
263                final String description;
264
265                final int bit;
266
267                Drop(int bit, String description) {
268                        this.description = description;
269                        this.bit = bit;
270                }
271
272        }
273
274        private void dropped(Drop reason, int size) {
275                metrics.errorCounter(LogMetrics.EVENTS_DROPPED_METRIC, size);
276                int previous;
277                do {
278                        previous = alertedReasons.get();
279                        if ((previous & reason.bit) != 0) {
280                                return;
281                        }
282                }
283                while (!alertedReasons.compareAndSet(previous, previous | reason.bit));
284                alerts.error(BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher.class,
285                                new IllegalStateException("Async publisher '" + name + "' dropped " + size + " event(s): "
286                                                + reason.description + ". Further drops for this reason are only counted in "
287                                                + LogMetrics.EVENTS_DROPPED_METRIC + "."));
288        }
289
290        private void consume() {
291                @Nullable Throwable failure = null;
292                try {
293                        LogEvent[] batch = new LogEvent[pending.length];
294                        while (true) {
295                                int size;
296                                lock.lock();
297                                try {
298                                        while (count == 0) {
299                                                if (state == State.CLOSING && producers == 0) {
300                                                        return;
301                                                }
302                                                readable.awaitUninterruptibly();
303                                        }
304                                        // Exchange ownership, without copying event references under the
305                                        // lock.
306                                        LogEvent[] empty = batch;
307                                        batch = pending;
308                                        pending = empty;
309                                        size = count;
310                                        count = 0;
311                                        queued.decrement(size);
312                                        writable.signal();
313                                }
314                                finally {
315                                        lock.unlock();
316                                }
317                                try {
318                                        appender.append(batch, size);
319                                }
320                                catch (RuntimeException | Error e) {
321                                        metrics.errorCounter(LogMetrics.EVENTS_FAILED_METRIC, size);
322                                        throw e;
323                                }
324                                finally {
325                                        Arrays.fill(batch, 0, size, null);
326                                }
327                        }
328                }
329                catch (RuntimeException | Error e) {
330                        failure = e;
331                }
332                finally {
333                        finish(failure);
334                }
335        }
336
337        private void finish(@Nullable Throwable failure) {
338                int discarded;
339                lock.lock();
340                try {
341                        state = failure == null ? State.CLOSING : State.FAILED;
342                        discarded = count;
343                        queued.decrement(count);
344                        Arrays.fill(pending, null);
345                        count = 0;
346                        writable.signalAll();
347                }
348                finally {
349                        lock.unlock();
350                }
351                try {
352                        // Stop admission and release waiters before notifying listeners.
353                        if (failure != null) {
354                                alerts.error(BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher.class, "Async worker failed.", failure);
355                        }
356                        if (discarded != 0) {
357                                dropped(Drop.WORKER_FAILED, discarded);
358                        }
359                }
360                finally {
361                        closeAppender();
362                }
363        }
364
365        private void closeAppender() {
366                try {
367                        appender.close();
368                }
369                catch (RuntimeException | Error e) {
370                        alerts.error(BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher.class, "Failed to close async appender.", e);
371                }
372                finally {
373                        lock.lock();
374                        try {
375                                state = State.CLOSED;
376                                terminated.signalAll();
377                        }
378                        finally {
379                                lock.unlock();
380                        }
381                }
382        }
383
384        @Override
385        public void close() {
386                boolean interrupted = Thread.interrupted();
387                boolean closeUnstarted = false;
388                boolean timedOut = false;
389                @Nullable InterruptedException interruptedWait = null;
390                lock.lock();
391                try {
392                        if (state == State.CLOSED) {
393                                return;
394                        }
395                        if (state == State.STARTING) {
396                                throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot close BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher during appender startup.");
397                        }
398                        if (state == State.NEW) {
399                                state = State.CLOSING;
400                                closeUnstarted = true;
401                        }
402                        else {
403                                if (state == State.RUNNING) {
404                                        state = State.CLOSING;
405                                        readable.signal();
406                                }
407                                if (Thread.currentThread().equals(worker)) {
408                                        return;
409                                }
410                                long remaining = shutdownNanos;
411                                while (state != State.CLOSED && remaining > 0) {
412                                        try {
413                                                remaining = terminated.awaitNanos(remaining);
414                                        }
415                                        catch (InterruptedException e) {
416                                                interrupted = true;
417                                                interruptedWait = e;
418                                                break;
419                                        }
420                                }
421                                timedOut = state != State.CLOSED;
422                        }
423                }
424                finally {
425                        lock.unlock();
426                        if (interrupted) {
427                                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
428                        }
429                }
430                if (closeUnstarted) {
431                        finish(null);
432                }
433                else if (interruptedWait != null) {
434                        alerts.error(BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher.class, "Interrupted while waiting for async publisher shutdown.",
435                                        interruptedWait);
436                }
437                else if (timedOut) {
438                        alerts.error(BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher.class, "Async publisher is still draining after close.",
439                                        new TimeoutException("Shutdown wait ended before the appender closed."));
440                }
441        }
442
443}
